groups.defect: When the join deadline expires, the outer loop breaks and skips cleanup of remaining workers.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same early break in join() and the resulting abandonment of later workers. Ensuring cleanup runs for every worker resolves both.

groups.defect: The global time.sleep monkeypatch makes the added flusher synchronization delay ineffective.
groups.rationale: One points at the ineffective delay and the other at the monkeypatch that disables it. The busy-loop observation describes another consequence of the same global sleep replacement.

partialOverlap.rationale: s_ca82d915 includes treating an explicit zero as an omitted limit, but also reports zero workers for empty shard assignments. Correcting the truthiness fallback alone does not resolve empty-assignment handling.
Both report missing worker/buffer handling for empty shard assignments, but s_ca82d915 additionally flags explicit zero being treated as a missing limit. These are independently triggered problems.
